_rationale: The existing mcp/git_analysis golden (invalid-scope) only proves dispatch reaches real validation -- it has no positive-path coverage. This spec uses the isolated git_fixture (same fixture as cli/git/git-analyze-commit and http/git-analyze-commit) with scope=commit, whose root-commit diff reads duplicate.go's two identical-body functions as Added. The harness's inner-text normalization (tests/integration/spec_runner.cpp NormalizeMcpInnerText) unconditionally masks 'summary' and 'metrics_issues' from every MCP golden (release-noise guard), so this spec cannot pin the metrics finding the CLI/HTTP siblings pin -- but it does NOT mask 'duplicates', so the real structural-duplicate finding survives normalization and is pinned here byte-for-byte (whole result.content[].text compare, same pattern as invalid-scope.json).
